items.html:
Plays for Pakistan CC in the South Florida Cricket League, Southeast Region, Florida. Played first-class cricket in Pakistan, played for Pakistan A v West Indies, toured with Pakistan `A' to Zimbabwa, played for USA in West Indies Cricket Board [WICB] Red Stripe Bowl tournament, 1998-99 in Jamaica, ICC tournament in Canada in 2001 and Argentina in 2002 also played for US team in ICC Six Nations Challenge in UAE 2004.
USACA (September 2004)
